24.original: Obtain flying shark livers from flying sharks.

25.original: Deliver the flying shark livers to Shihoji.

48.original: <hex:02080FE905FF064D6164616DFF0453697203>? <hex:021A020203><hex:02080FE905FF064D6164616DFF0453697203><hex:021A020103>! Might you bring me three flying shark livers? You can find them on the northern tip of this island.

49.original: I would go myself, but alas, I have grown too weak in my old age to hunt anything so fierce. That said, you shall, of course, be rewarded for your help.

50.original: Please bring me the livers of three flying sharks. You should be able to find them to the north of here.

51.original: Have you brought me my livers?

52.original: Excellent! Thank you, <hex:02080FE905FF066D6164616DFF0473697203>. Now I shall finally be able to make myself some liver oil!

53.original: It will help me to keep my eyes sharp. They are my greatest asset, after all. With my hawk-like vision, I can see everything─including the sobbing faces of those spineless bakufu soldiers at the Ruby Price. Hahaha!

54.original: While I can no longer fight, for the next twenty years I intend to earn my keep at the Confederacy as a lookout!
